Capture Claude Code background subagents into checkpoints

Claude Code runs most Agent calls in the background without the model passing run_in_background (or passes it as the string "true"), so the launch was classified as foreground, completed empty, and dropped. Its SubagentStop also carries agent_id but never tool_use_id, so even a recorded marker was never found.

Classify the launch from tool_response.status ("async_launched" / "completed"), which Claude Code reports authoritatively, falling back to run_in_background (boolean or boolean string). At SubagentStop, find the launch record by agent ID (preferring a live record, for resumed subagents) and adopt its tool_use_id. The integration harness now sends the payload shapes Claude Code 2.1.288 actually sends.

lifecycle: log a re-woken subagent's repeated stop at debug

A background subagent stops again each time a child it launched wakes
it (a forked skill fanning out, or an Agent call with background
children). Its later SubagentStops find the record its first stop
completed, by agent ID, and were logged as a missing in-flight marker
warning. That is expected; only a stop that named its tool call and
still found no live record is worth a warning.

claude-code: verify a Workflow agent's transcript and key each run's stop

A Workflow agent's SubagentStop transcript path came straight from the hook
payload, and the capture read whatever existing file it named into the
checkpoint. It is now used only when it is exactly
<session>/subagents/workflows/<runId>/agent-<id>.jsonl for this session and
agent inside the parent's session directory, with no link below it;
anything else is dropped and the layout lookup applies.

That file's run is passed on as SubagentRunID. A resumed run reuses its
agents' IDs, so its launch found the earlier run's completed record (not
yet condensed) and added none, and its stop was then skipped as a
duplicate, losing the run's files, transcript and tokens. The stop now
completes a record of its own unless one already holds the same run's
transcript, whichever order the runs' stops arrive in.
